apps.title: Credit tracker
apps.prompt: For every student, credits earned against the credits needed to graduate, and whether they are on pace for their grade level. Sort the furthest behind to the top.

apps.title: ADA attendance report
apps.prompt: Days enrolled and days present per student per month, with the school-wide apportionment rate, so I can show the county how attendance was counted.

apps.title: Plan review calendar
apps.prompt: Every active IEP, 504, behavior support and transition plan with its review date. Overdue first, then what is due in the next 30 and 60 days.

apps.title: Re-engagement list
apps.prompt: Students absent three or more of the last ten school days, with their advisor and the last contact note, so nobody drifts away unnoticed.
